fields.name: isPublished
fields.label: Published
fields.description: Only published entries appear on the site. New entries start unpublished — turn this on when the entry is ready. Edits to a published entry go live as soon as you save.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Headline shown at the top of the published post and in post listings.

fields.name: date
fields.label: Publish Date
fields.description: When the post is published. Posts are ordered by this date, newest first.

fields.name: updated
fields.label: Last Updated
fields.description: Optional. When the post was last substantively revised.

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author
fields.description: Shown as a byline under the title. Leave blank to show no author.

fields.name: tags
fields.label: Tags
fields.description: Pick country names from the dropdown (e.g. Poland, Germany). Each tag draws a flag and adds the country to the post's map. Typing a value not on the list is allowed but may not resolve to a flag/map.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Featured image shown at the top of the post.

fields.name: imageAttribution
fields.label: Image Attribution
fields.description: Photo credit shown in small text under the image. '(CC BY-SA 3.0)' is added automatically.

fields.name: imageAttributionUrl
fields.label: Image Attribution URL
fields.description: Optional link for the photo credit (e.g. the source page). If set, the credit text becomes clickable.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: The main article text. Use the toolbar for headings, lists, links, and quotes.

fields.name: isPublished
fields.label: Published
fields.description: Only published entries appear on the site. New entries start unpublished — turn this on when the entry is ready. Edits to a published entry go live as soon as you save.

fields.name: englishName
fields.label: Primary Name
fields.description: The main name, used in the page title, listings, and search. Usually the English name.

fields.name: translations
fields.label: Translations
fields.description: The commission's name in other languages. Add one row per language.

fields.name: language
fields.label: Language
fields.description: Pick a language from the dropdown (e.g. English, German). Stored as its short code (en, de). The 'en' entry is what surfaces the English name across the site.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: The commission's name written in the language above.

fields.name: proposedDate
fields.label: Proposed Date
fields.description: When the commission was first proposed. Shown in the details table as 'Proposed'. Use Jan 1 if only the year is known.

fields.name: startDate
fields.label: Start Date
fields.description: When the commission actually began. Shown as 'Founded' and used when sorting the list by date. Use Jan 1 if only the year is known.

fields.name: lastActiveStatusDate
fields.label: Last Active Status Date
fields.description: Most recent date its activity was confirmed. Shown as 'Last active'. Use Jan 1 if only the year is known.

fields.name: lastActiveStatus
fields.label: Last Active Status
fields.description: Last known activity, shown as plain text in the details table. Same vocabulary as the colored Status badge below, but this is a historical note recording the status as of the 'Last Active Status Date'.

fields.name: memberCountries
fields.label: Member Countries
fields.description: Pick country names from the dropdown (e.g. Poland, Germany). These draw the map, the globe arcs, and the flag tags. Picking from the list guarantees correct spelling; typing a value not on the list is allowed but may not render.

fields.name: sponsoringInstitutions
fields.label: Sponsoring Institutions
fields.description: Organizations that established or fund the commission. Shown in the details.

fields.name: keyTopics
fields.label: Key Topics
fields.description: Main research areas. Shown as a bulleted 'Key Topics' list on the page.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Title of the publication, shown in the Publications list.

fields.name: year
fields.label: Year
fields.description: Publication year, shown next to the title.

fields.name: url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: Link to the publication. If set, the title becomes a clickable link.

fields.name: format
fields.label: Format
fields.description: Document type. Note: this is NOT shown anywhere on the public site yet — for internal categorization only.

fields.name: workingGroups
fields.label: Working Groups
fields.description: Names of sub-committees or working groups within the commission.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Current status. Sets the colored badge on the page and list.

fields.name: chairs
fields.label: Chairs
fields.description: People who lead the commission. Add one row per chair.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Full name of the chair.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.description: Country the chair is based in or represents. Pick from the dropdown, or type a value not on the list.

fields.name: affiliation
fields.label: Affiliation
fields.description: University or institution the chair belongs to (optional).

fields.name: url
fields.label: Commission Website
fields.description: The site to link to. If the live site is dead, set Link Status to 'Dead' below and we send visitors to the Wayback Machine copy automatically — no need to paste an archive URL.

fields.name: linkStatus
fields.label: Link Status

options.label: Live — link directly to the site
Dead — send visitors to the Wayback Machine archive
Not located yet — no link shown

fields.description: Live shows a Website link. Dead builds an automatic Wayback Machine archive link from the URL above. Not located hides the link (use while still searching for the site).

fields.name: archivableDocuments
fields.label: Archivable Documents
fields.description: Important documents worth preserving. Add one row per document.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Name of the document.

fields.name: url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: Direct link to the document.

fields.name: siteTitle
fields.label: Site Title
fields.description: Shown in the masthead, browser tab, footer and feeds.

fields.name: kicker
fields.label: Masthead Kicker
fields.description: Small uppercase line above the title (e.g. 'A digital archive').

fields.name: description
fields.label: Meta Description
fields.description: Used for SEO and social sharing previews.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Navigation

fields.name: shortLabel
fields.label: Short Label
fields.description: Used where space is tight, e.g. on phones.
Links in the site header, in order.

fields.name: copyrightHolder
fields.label: Copyright Holder
fields.description: Name after the © year.

fields.name: subtitle
fields.label: Subtitle
fields.description: Caption on the link-preview image.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Body
fields.description: Main about text, in Markdown: *italic*, **bold**, [link text](https://…), blank line between paragraphs.

fields.name: contact
fields.label: Contact / Maintainer
fields.description: Shown in smaller text below the body, in Markdown. Use links for names and emails.
